1.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
1.summary: A wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings are among the images obtained by the BBC's partner CBS News.

2.title: U.S. Fast-Tracked Deportation of Ecuadorean Politician Despite Torture Fears
2.summary: The removal of José Serrano, a critic of President Daniel Noboa who has been accused of criminal activity, underscores how the Trump administration has asserted control over U.S. immigration courts.

3.title: News Helicopter Crash in Los Angeles Underscores the Risks of Aerial Reporting
3.summary: Swarms of helicopters traverse the vast region to capture its mayhem. Then, one became the story. “It was the day we all dread,” one pilot said.

4.title: At Least 21 Dead in Gaza After Building Collapse, Officials Say
4.summary: The building was previously damaged by an Israeli strike, the local rescue service said. Its fall underscored the severe risks for many people living among Gaza’s ruins.

5.title: Houthis and Saudis Trade Claims of Military Attacks as Conflict Escalates
5.summary: The Houthis, an Iran-backed militia in Yemen, said they had downed a Saudi jet, while Saudi authorities accused the group of firing a drone near Mecca. The Houthis denied doing so.

6.title: Belarus Releases 25 Political Prisoners in Exchange for U.S. Easing of Sanctions
6.summary: The deal is part of the Trump administration’s more transactional approach to a close Russian ally that Europe has tried to isolate.
